$comment: High and critical npm advisories that are knowingly accepted, checked by scripts/check-npm-audit.mjs.
An entry is only legitimate when no forward fix exists: if npm offers a non-breaking upgrade, take the upgrade.
Every entry needs a reason that says why the advisory is not reachable in this product, and an expiry.
The gate fails once expires passes, once the advisory reaches a dependent outside dependents,
and once the advisory stops being reported at all -- so entries cannot quietly outlive their justification.

exceptions.reason: Unbounded-expansion DoS, reached only through Docusaurus's local serve-handler path (brace-expansion -> minimatch -> serve-handler -> @docusaurus/core). Production documentation is deployed as static Cloudflare assets, so the Node serve-handler is not deployed; locally, docusaurus serve passes boolean cleanUrls and directoryListing settings and no user-controlled glob configuration, so HTTP request input does not reach the vulnerable expansion path. No compatible forward fix exists: Docusaurus 3.10.2 and serve-handler 6.1.7 are current, minimatch 3 requires brace-expansion 1.x, and the first patched brace-expansion is 5.0.8.
exceptions.review: Before expiry, check for a Docusaurus or serve-handler release on a patched dependency chain and upgrade and remove this exception if one exists; otherwise revalidate reachability against the current website configuration as tracked in issue #31.
